content.title: Corporate Partnership
content.paragraph: Partner with us to create sustainable social impact through CSR initiatives, community programs, and long-term development projects.

content.heading: Why Partner With Us?
paragraphs: MANN Care Foundation works at the grassroots level focusing on women, children, education, health, hygiene, animal welfare, and environment. Through corporate partnerships, we aim to scale impact and create measurable social change aligned with CSR goals.

items.title: Education CSR
items.desc: School kits, digital learning, scholarships, and skill development.

items.title: Nutrition Programs
items.desc: Food distribution, hunger relief, and malnutrition support.

items.title: Health Initiatives
items.desc: Medical camps, hygiene awareness, and healthcare support.

items.title: Women Empowerment
items.desc: Skill training, livelihood programs, and self-reliance support.

items.title: Environment CSR
items.desc: Tree plantation, waste management, and sustainability drives.

items.title: Animal Welfare
items.desc: Feeding, rescue, and medical support for animals in need.

steps.title: CSR compliance & reporting support
steps.desc: We provide complete documentation and reporting to meet your CSR compliance requirements with transparency.

steps.title: Transparent impact documentation
steps.desc: Get detailed impact reports with data, photos, and stories showing the real difference your partnership makes.

steps.title: Brand visibility in social initiatives
steps.desc: Your brand gets recognized across our campaigns, events, and communication channels as a socially responsible partner.

steps.title: Community engagement opportunities
steps.desc: Engage your employees in meaningful volunteering activities and on-ground visits to witness impact firsthand.

steps.title: Long-term partnership model
steps.desc: Build a sustainable, long-term collaboration that evolves with your CSR goals and creates lasting community impact.

content.heading: Let's Create Impact Together
content.paragraph: Partner with MANN Care Foundation for meaningful CSR collaboration.
